meta.population_source: GHSL GHS-POP R2023A, 30 arc-sec WGS84, CC BY 4.0
meta.epoch_rule: epoch nearest the candidate start year

fields.pop_exposed_50mm: people in cells whose candidate total >= 50 mm
fields.pop_exposed_30mmh: people in cells with any 30-min peak >= 30 mm/h
fields.pop_weighted_rain_mm: sum(cell total x cell pop) / sum(cell pop)
fields.urban_cells: cells holding the top 80% of the AOI population
fields.urban_cells_over_threshold: cells over threshold among the urban cells
fields.exposure_rank: secondary: rank by pop_exposed_50mm (saturates; skews recent)

meta.note: records keep all Task 07 fields; 'rank' is the Task 07 severity rank; records are sorted by 'pwr_rank' (population-weighted rain); 'exposure_rank' orders by pop_exposed_50mm (ties by pop_weighted_rain_mm)
